_comment: What the running fabric reports it listens on (APP-093). This is the shape
inventory actually hands us — listeners per workload, not edges — so one record
resolves every declared edge pointing at that workload.
This stack declares `protocol: internal` with no interfaces, so the compiler
cannot resolve a port from intent alone. Inventory fills the gap and stamps
port_source=inventory, which is deliberately weaker evidence than a declared
port: it says what IS, not what was INTENDED. The remaining work — declaring
these ports in CALM — stays visible rather than being quietly closed.
`external-state` is listed twice on purpose: a workload listening on two ports
does not tell us which one an edge uses, so that edge stays UNADJUDICABLE.
Guessing would fabricate a precise claim out of imprecise evidence.
